pages.title: A New Way of Travelling
pages.text: This bad boy lets you travel back to your $(thing)Spawnpoint$() from wherever you are for a resonable price.

pages.title: The Heart
pages.text: The centre piece of your new mirror is the $(item)Soul Mirror$(). Reflecting the place your soul feels most connected to, home.

pages.title: Crafting the Heart
pages.text: Combine these in either a $(item)Crafting Table$() or if $(thing)Create$() is installed pressed inside of a $(thing)Superheated$() $(item)Basin$().

pages.title: Crafting the Mirror
pages.text: Combine these in either a $(item)Crafting Table$() or if $(thing)Create$() is installed as a $(thing)Sequenced Assembly$().
